svg.title: Where Amur leopards live
svg.desc: A simplified map of the border country between the Russian Far East and north east China, north of the Korean Peninsula. Amur leopards live in temperate forest in south west Primorsky Krai, protected by Land of the Leopard National Park, and across the border in Jilin and Heilongjiang provinces, protected by the Northeast China Tiger and Leopard National Park. A joint Russian and Chinese census counted 223 leopards in total.
